note: One of the bar pieces: a row of n cells on a row of n + 1, with one cell under the left end. Every n = 1 (mod 4) gives a 2(n+1) x (n+3) tiling with n + 3 copies (tools/bar-family.ts). Other lengths behave very differently: n = 3 needs 180 copies, n = 4 needs 138 and n = 8 needs 468, while n = 6 and 7 are open.

order.note: Upper bound from a 28 x 16 tiling; every rectangle with at most 12 copies was ruled out by exhaustive search.
